name: Troyes

categories.label: Victory points gained in play
categories.help: Total of the victory point tokens you collected during the game.

categories.label: Events you are present on
categories.help: Un-countered event cards (including Marauding) where you have a cube; 1 point each.

categories.label: Tradesmen on activity cards
categories.help: Total of the points printed on the spaces your citizens occupy on activity cards.

categories.label: Cathedral levels with no cubes
categories.help: How many of the 3 cathedral levels you have no cubes on (lose 2 points each).

categories.label: Character cards
categories.help: Points you score from all the revealed character cards, including other players' characters.

source.edition_or_year: Pearl Games, 2010 game; rules file dated April 2017

notes: Base game only; Dice, Ladies of Troyes, bonus cards and the solo rules (le Roy) are out of scope. Read from the publisher-hosted PDF. The rulebook states no tie-break, so ties are shared. Round count depends on player count (6, 5 or 4) so rounds is null. Supported players 2 to 4 from the rulebook setup text. Character card points depend on each character's own criteria; enter the sum.
